Indonesian

[edit]
Indonesian Wikipedia has an article on:
polen
Wikipedia id

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism, from Dutch pollen, from Latin pollen.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpolən/
  • Rhymes: -lən, -ən, -n
  • Hyphenation: po‧lên

Noun

[edit]

polên (plural polen-polen)

  1. (botany) pollen: A fine granular substance produced in flowers. Technically a collective term for pollen grains (microspores) produced in the anthers of flowering plants
    Synonym: serbuk sari

Synonyms

[edit]
  • debunga (Standard Malay)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • polen lebah

Further reading

[edit]
  • “polen”, in Kamus Besar Bahasa Indonesia [Great Dictionary of the Indonesian Language] (in Indonesian), Jakarta: Agency for Language Development and Cultivation – Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology of the Republic of Indonesia, 2016
